items.period: Shuowen seal-script tradition; transmitted entry compiled in the Han, with this digital drawing uploaded 2013
items.tradition: Small seal script / Shuowen-style modern vector redraw
items.caption: Modern vector rendering of the seal-script form analyzed in Shuowen as 从步戌聲; the inscription-era forms have other reported analyses.
items.alt: Black vector outline of the 歲 graph in Shuowen seal-script style.
items.selection_reason: Exact Commons file page identifies the depicted character, script style, linked source record, original SVG URL, and public-domain status. It illustrates the later lexicographic form without presenting it as an ancient artifact photograph.
items.rights: Public domain, as stated on the exact Wikimedia Commons file description page.

limitations.text: Only a modern seal-style redraw had verified identity and reuse provenance in this pass; its pixels were not visually inspected by the researcher. No oracle-bone or bronze candidate is proposed.
